# M2 soft outputs (generated by scripts/m2_summary.py)

Train split only (20,000 shots per experiment); r=13 has no Train shots. Per-shot outputs: `results/cache/soft/`; per-experiment metrics: `results/m2_train_metrics.csv`.

## Check: gap predictions against plain MWPM (M1), all shots

840 experiment-prior pairs. Error counts identical in 635; largest difference -94 errors in 50,000 shots; total difference 6. Tied shots (gap = 0): 99652.
